div.div:
حَسِكٌ (assumed tropical:) Affected with rancour, malevolence, malice, or spite; and enmity: (TA:) or angry. (K.) You say, إِنَّهُ لَحَسِكُ الصَّدْرِ عَلَى فُلَانٍ (assumed tropical:) Verily he is affected with rancour, &c., of the bosom against such a one. (TA.) ―
-b2- حَسِكٌ مَرِسٌ (assumed tropical:) Courageous [and strong]; not to be attempted [in fight]. (A, TA.) [See also حَسَكٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
